data.name: Arunkumar
data.gender_notes: Arunkumar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Arunkumar is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘arun’ which means ‘red’ or ‘dawn’, and ‘kumar’ which means ‘younger brother of Lord Krishna’. This name signifies the one who is as radiant as the sun at dawn. It is also the name of Lord Arun, the god of rain in Hindu mythology. The name Arunkumar carries the meaning “Sun's chariot, warrior god” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Arunkumar usually hope their child will grow to embody sun's chariot, warrior god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the radiant and powerful energy of the sun and the divine grace of Lord Krishna.
data.etymology: Arunkumar belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sun's chariot, warrior god.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arunkumar total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The name Arunkumar holds significant cultural importance in Hindu tradition where the name is often given to boys as a mark of reverence towards Lord Krishna and Arun, the god of rain. In India, it is believed that the Dawn God Arun brings the blessings of rain and prosperity, thus associating the name with good fortune and prosperity.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Arunkumar carries a deep spiritual significance as it reminds the bearer of the divine qualities of being radiant, resilient, and nurturing, much like the dawn and Lord Krishna. It also highlights the strong brotherly bond between Arunkumar (indicating Lord Krishna) and Krishna, emphasizing the importance of brotherhood and devotion towards deities.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Arunkumar: Radiant or Red-hued God (Arun) + Grace (Kumar). It symbolizes the embodiment of divine grace and the radiance of the god Aruna, often depicted as the charioteer of the sun god Surya.
